title: The data model comes alive
objective: Learners see a health plan's core data model (member, policy, provider, authorization, claim, claim line, payment, case, appeal, letter) as a picture that a process walks through, so the boxes and lines of an entity diagram become the records a real enrolment, claim or appeal creates and touches, and the owning teams show who has to agree before the model changes.

recommended.why: An entity diagram is boxes with fields and labelled lines; React Flow gives both and lets the process light up objects and relations in order.

alternative.why: The entity diagram shows how the objects relate; the ownership tree shows who owns them and how often a process crosses a team boundary. Which one makes the governance conversation easier?

assumptions: The ten objects, their fields, relations, owning teams and the three processes are illustrative; they are not a product schema or a real plan's model

Generic names map to Salesforce-flavoured ones (Account, Member Plan, Healthcare Provider, Care Request, Claim, Claim Line Item, Payment, Case, Communication) for the names switch; the structure is identical
Each event creates, links or updates exactly one object and arrives along one existing relation; events are three playback seconds apart
A hand-off is two consecutive events on objects owned by different teams
Ownership colours the objects by team and counts hand-offs; it does not change the events
units: counts: objects touched, teams involved, hand-offs
checkDescription: Every event, relation and path entry refers to an existing object; the touched set is exactly the objects the events visit; every link an event travels is a relation of the model; teams involved and hand-offs follow from the owners; events are three seconds apart with one marker each; the names switch changes labels only.

learnerPrompts.predict: Switch to An appeal before you play. Which objects will the process touch that a claim does not, and how many teams will be involved?
learnerPrompts.explain: With ownership on, the claim process crosses team boundaries several times. Which single relation would you put a data contract on first, and why?
